headline: Backend-focused software engineer
summary: Backend-focused software engineer with experience designing and building distributed, real-time systems using Python, Java, FastAPI, and event-driven architectures. Experienced in developing scalable REST APIs, secure authentication systems, streaming applications with Apache Kafka, and containerized backend services. Strong foundation in software engineering principles, database design, distributed systems, and object-oriented programming.

projects.name: Taskflow -- Collaborative Task Management Platform
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack Project
bullets: Built a full-stack platform for creating, assigning, and tracking tasks across teams, with role-based access control, activity history, and CSV export.
Designed a FastAPI REST API backed by PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy, with Alembic migrations and background jobs for email reminders.
Reduced average page load time by 42% (1.8s to 1.05s) by adding query indexes and caching frequently read project metadata.
Wrote 120 backend and 35 frontend tests gating CI, and documented the API with OpenAPI examples.

projects.name: Streamline -- Real-Time Event Analytics Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Distributed Systems Project
bullets: Built a distributed real-time event analytics pipeline using Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, and PostgreSQL.
Designed a Kafka-based ingestion layer that processes 2.4M events per day with at-least-once delivery and idempotent consumers.
Developed REST APIs for metrics aggregation, search, and operational monitoring, and added Grafana dashboards for latency and throughput.
Containerized the services with Docker Compose and wrote unit and integration tests for aggregation and anomaly detection workflows.
